page.title: Ask Talon
page.intro: Ask Talon, the SOC's AI analyst, about your alerts, its AI reports and your assets.
page.reviewNotice: Chats may be reviewed by your SOC.
page.noActionsNotice: Talon can't take actions. It answers questions, and can draft a question for your SOC that you send yourself.
page.unavailableText: Your SOC hasn't turned on Ask Talon for your organization.
